inputs.text: [excited] Twenty feet long — [amazed] as long as a road is wide — it takes up the whole street. Standing up, five feet tall — [curious] as tall as a car — you'd have to look up. And two thousand two hundred kilos — [proud] as heavy as a rhino. [calm] And slow: about 4 miles an hour, like Dad walking fast.
[confident] Yep, [pauses] even its eyes were protected. [proud] The most armored dinosaur in all of history.
